predecessors.name: Kingdom of Munster
predecessors.text: all of County Cork and most of County Kerry

successors.name: Kingdom of Ireland
successors.text: 'Following the Nine Years' War of the 1590s, Desmond became part of the Kingdom of Ireland'; partitioned between County Cork and County Kerry in 1606

ledger.x: 1118: Tadhg Mac Carthaigh founds the Kingdom of Desmond.
1177: Henry II grants Desmond to FitzStephen and de Cogan.
1596: the last MacCarthy Mor king dies and Desmond becomes part of the Kingdom of Ireland.

wars.name: Battle of Callann
wars.outcome: MacCarthy victory over the Anglo-Normans, which 'helped preserve Desmond's independence'.

wars.name: Desmond Rebellions
wars.outcome: Fought by the Earls of Desmond, not the MacCarthy kings; recorded in the Kingdom of Ireland dossier.

certainty.note: The frontier with the Earldom is unmarked on the page.
